authorInfo.bio: Charles Dickens was an English novelist and journalist whose memorable characters brought Victorian society to life. His stories combine humour, sympathy and criticism of poverty and injustice. His works include Oliver Twist, David Copperfield, Bleak House and Great Expectations.

sourceTitle: Sketches by Boz, Illustrative of Every-Day Life and Every-Day People
description: "Sketches by Boz, Illustrative of Every-Day Life and Every-Day People" by Charles Dickens is a collection of short pieces originally published between 1833 and 1836. Dickens's first book captures vivid snapshots of London scenes and people through fifty-six sketches divided into four sections.
